fusions.name: Wormwood Tooth
fusions.desc: A quick bite that deals 4 damage and makes the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction already on the target, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Wrung Dry
fusions.desc: Only strikes a target at or below 30% health, a threshold that rises with each rank. You clamp it for 16 damage and draw out every affliction on it, adding 1.2 times the damage they had left and 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Bitter Hide
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 60% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it.

fusions.name: Clean Blood
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 12, and you carry 15% poison resistance.
